how_to_apply: Applications are made offline. Candidates download the application form provided as a link to the advertisement, fill it in and send it by post with photocopies of the listed documents to:
Manager (HR &A), Bharat Electronics Limited, Plot No .L-1, MIDC, Industrial Area, Taloja, Navi Mumbai -410208.
Download the application form from the link given with the advertisement.
Fill in the form with one valid e-mail ID, as all correspondence is by e-mail.
Pay the application fee through SBI Collect (online) if not exempted, and attach the screenshot of the receipt.
Attach the photocopies of the documents listed below.
Write 'Application for the post of Medical Officer (E-II grade) on Fixed Term basis' on the envelope.
Send the envelope by post to the address above so that it is received by 15.12.2026.

The fee is remitted through SBI Collect (Online). Cheque, DD or cash is not accepted, and fee once paid is not refunded for whatever reason. Only the fee paid for this advertisement to BEL Navi Mumbai is considered.
Selection is through a written test followed by an interview of only those candidates who qualify the written test, in the ratio of 1:7.
The written test has questions for 85 marks from the Medical domain/General Aptitude.
Qualifying marks are 35% (UR) and 30% (PwBD). OBC/SC/ST candidates are considered on par with UR candidates.
The assessment weightage is 85% for the written test and 15% for the interview.

Call letters go to the e-mail IDs of eligible candidates. Date, time and centre of the written test will be intimated by e-mail in due course, and interview intimation is given to shortlisted candidates via e-mail only.

Outstation candidates shortlisted for interview are reimbursed AC Chair Car / III Tier AC class train fare by the shortest route between the correspondence address and the place of interview, on production of valid train tickets. Fare for attending the written test is not reimbursed.
important_instructions: Employees of Govt./Quasi Govt./PSUs must submit the No Objection Certificate at the time of interview, otherwise they are not allowed to appear for it. Incomplete applications without the mandatory enclosures are summarily rejected without assigning any reason. PwBD certificates must be in the prescribed proforma on www.bel-india.in, issued by the prescribed authority; only candidates with disability of not less than 40% are eligible for PwBD reservation and relaxation. Change of category once declared in the application form is not entertained. Appointment is subject to the candidate being found medically fit by the Company's medical authorities. A candidate called to report on selection must get a medical examination done by a Civil Surgeon/Asst. Civil Surgeon of a District Government Hospital. Any past litigation with an employer must be intimated at the time of interview. Canvassing in any form results in disqualification. BEL does not charge any fee other than the application fee at any stage. Revisions, corrigenda and time extensions will be hosted on the career section of the BEL website, with no separate press notification.

content_sections.heading: About BEL
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited describes itself as India's leading professional Electronics Company and a Navratna category Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The notice is issued from Plot No. L-1, M.I.D.C Industrial Area, Taloja, Navi Mumbai- 410208, and the openings are for the Navi Mumbai and Pune Units.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post with 02 vacancies. The notice names no separate department. The number of posts may vary based on the actual requirement at the time of selection. Management also reserves the right to increase or decrease the vacancies.

rows.post_and_grade: Medical Officer (E-II) On Fixed Term Basis

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Academic, research or teaching work experience is not considered as relevant post qualification experience. The AFIH (Associate Fellowship in Industrial Safety & Health), Maharashtra qualification is preferred. A selected candidate without it shall acquire it within one year. The degree must be from an Indian University/Institution, meaning a university incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature, another institution established by an Act of Parliament, or one declared deemed to be a university under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. The candidate should have a valid central/National registration certificate issued by the National Medical Commission/Medical Council of India/State Medical Council or another authority notified by the Government of India. Candidates whose educational qualification in the degree certificate does not tally with the prescribed qualification will not be considered for selection. Only Indian nationals need to apply. The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.11.2026. PwBD candidates with minimum 40% disability and the prescribed Disability Certificate from the Competent Authority get 10 years of relaxation. For ex-servicemen, age relaxation is as per government guidelines. OBC/SC/ST candidates applying against the UR post are considered on par with UR candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.qualification: MBBS from a recognized University/Institution approved by the National Medical Commission/Medical Council of India in the relevant discipline, with minimum Pass Class
rows.experience: Minimum 1 year of relevant post qualification experience as on 01.11.2026

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: In addition to Basic Pay, the allowances and benefits named in the notice are Dearness allowance, Non Practicing allowance (20% of Basic Pay), House Rent Allowance, 35% of the Basic Pay as Perquisites, Performance Related Pay (PRP), Group Insurance, Medical facilities and Provident Fund, as per the Company's rules. These are part of the remuneration package. The CTC will be Rs. 13.63 Lakhs (approx.). The Medical Officer is engaged initially for five years. The engagement may be extended up to a maximum of two years (maximum tenure of 7 years) based on requirement and individual performance. The openings are for the Navi Mumbai and Pune Units, but the selected candidate may be required to serve at other locations if the need arises, as per Company's requirement.

content_sections.heading: BEL Medical Officer (E-II) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Medical Officer is required to take care of various activities like: Medical services for employees in the factory (consultation and treatment). Processing of medical bills: checking prescriptions and reports, and line item wise checking of bills with the Schedule of charges (SOCs) of empanelled hospital rates and standard hospital rates, which vary from case to case. Administration of the CMA Scheme and monitoring of the BERECHS Scheme. Scrutiny and processing of bills in SAP. Liaisoning with panel hospitals, OSH Code authorities for health related matters, and the Medicine Dispensing Agency (Empanelled Pharmacy). Periodic medical checkup under the Maharashtra OSH Code/Rules, and coordination and conduct of preventive health checkup for employees. Medical consultation for dependents in BEL Township. Monitoring medicine dispensation for employees and conducting health awareness sessions. Maintaining the medical register for OPD and IPD bill records. Ensuring that services provided by hospitals and agency (OPD, IPD, Pharmacy) are as per the agreed terms and conditions. Facilitating audits such as ISO, Safety and Health Audits, and medical camps under CSR. Any other job(s) in their area of operation allotted by the Management from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Birth date proof: Birth Certificate or Matriculation marks sheet with clear mention of date of birth. 02 passport size photos. All certificates in support of educational qualifications, from Matriculation/Class X/Diploma/PUC/Class XII/Degree/PG. All semester/year wise mark sheets of MBBS and PG Diploma/Degree if any, and the qualifying degree final/provisional certificate. Registration certificate with National Medical Commission/Medical Council of India/State Medical Council or other notified authority. AFIH certificate, Maharashtra (if available). Conversion formula certificate for CGPA/DGPA/OGPA or letter grade to percentage marks and awarded class, certified by the University/Institution, wherever applicable. Caste certificate in the prescribed format for OBC (NCL)/EWS/SC/ST candidates, available on the BEL website. The OBC certificate must be issued on or after 01.11.2026 and the EWS certificate for the year 2026-27. Payment receipt copy through SBI Collect (online) for General and OBC candidates. Disability certificate in the prescribed format, if the candidate belongs to the PwBD category. No objection certificate if employed in Government/Quasi Government and Public Sector undertakings. Experience certificate from the previous and present employer with joining/exit date and job responsibilities. Where the current employment certificate is not produced, the joining/appointment letter, first and latest payslip and employee id proof must be attached.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer vacancies are there in BEL?
faq.answer: BEL has notified 02 Medical Officer (E-II) posts on a fixed term basis, both unreserved (UR-02), for its Navi Mumbai and Pune Units.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEL Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application is 15.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BEL Medical Officer (E-II)?
faq.answer: MBBS from a recognized University/Institution approved by the National Medical Commission/Medical Council of India in the relevant discipline, with minimum Pass Class, plus 1 year of relevant post qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEL Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years as on 01.11.2026, with 10 years relaxation for PwBD candidates with minimum 40% disability.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BEL Medical Officer (E-II)?
faq.answer: The Pay Scale is Rs. 40,000-3%-1,40,000 at the time of joining, with a CTC of Rs. 13.63 Lakhs (approx.).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.472/- (Rs.400/- + 18% GST), paid through SBI Collect. PwBD/SC/ST/Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BEL Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Download the application form, fill it in, attach photocopies of the listed documents and send it by post to Manager (HR &A), Bharat Electronics Limited, Plot No .L-1, MIDC, Industrial Area, Taloja, Navi Mumbai -410208.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A written test of 85 marks is followed by an interview of qualifying candidates in the ratio of 1:7, with weightage of 85% and 15% respectively.

faq.question: Q9. Is the BEL Medical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on a fixed term basis of five years, extendable up to a maximum of two years (maximum tenure of 7 years) based on requirement and performance.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel fare be reimbursed for the test and interview?
faq.answer: Outstation candidates shortlisted for interview get AC Chair Car / III Tier AC train fare on production of tickets. Fare for the written test is not reimbursed.
